name: @ci/capacitor-local-llm
description: Capacitor plugin (Android-only) for on-device LLM inference via Google's LiteRT-LM. Downloads, loads and runs the catalog models in LOCAL_LLM_MODELS (Qwen3, Qwen2.5, Gemma 4) fully offline once a model is on disk, on CPU or GPU, with an optional reasoning channel, photo input for Gemma 4, and per-turn speed stats. This package ships the Android half only: iOS implements the identical JS contract as an in-app Swift plugin (frontend/apps/ios/ios/App/App/LocalLLM) and capacitorPluginContract.test.ts keeps the two in step. The web layer reaches either through @ci/common's localLlm.ts.
